description: Single-file bundle containing the original command scripts and README from the uploaded repository.
readme:
# SMM Panel Telegram Bot (Bots.Business)

Import via Tools -> Git Sync. Set bot Properties: SMM_API_KEY, ADMIN_IDS, UPI_ID, SUPPORT_CONTACT.
Then send /sync to the bot.

addfunds.js
commands.source:
/*CMD
  command: /addfunds
  help: Add money
  need_reply: false
  auto_retry_time: 
  folder: 
  answer: 
  keyboard: 
  aliases: ➕ Add Funds
  group: 
CMD*/

var upi = Bot.getProperty("UPI_ID") || "(admin has not set UPI_ID)";
Bot.sendMessage("➕ *Add Funds (UPI)*\n\n1️⃣ Pay to UPI ID:\n`" + upi + "`\n2️⃣ Copy the *UTR / Reference ID* from your payment app.\n3️⃣ Send amount like this:\n\n`/paid 100 123456789012`\n\n(amount then UTR). Balance is added after admin verifies your payment.");

commands.name: status.js
commands.source:
/*CMD
  command: /status
  help: 
  need_reply: false
  auto_retry_time: 
  folder: 
  answer: 
  keyboard: 
  aliases: 
  group: 
CMD*/

HTTP.post({
  url: Bot.getProperty("SMM_API_URL") || "https://smpanel.in/api/v2",
  body: { key: Bot.getProperty("SMM_API_KEY"), action: "status", order: String(params).trim() },
  success: "/onStatus", error: "/onApiError"
});
